get_main_module: get the decorated main function from a DORA training package by module name and package
get_main_env: get the main function using DORA_MAIN_MODULE and DORA_PACKAGE environment variables
find_package_auto: find a training package in the current directory that contains the specified main module
review_get_main: review the get_main function to understand how it resolves and imports DORA training modules
refactor_find_package: refactor the _find_package function to support custom search paths beyond the current working directory
